description: Arcane-caster-style burst mage - builds a Frost/Fire/Arcane Glyph chain off Elemental Burst and Primordial Blast, then detonates it with Glyphic Ruin or Thaumaturgy.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc (real playstyle/rotation/ability names) + confirmed screenshot numbers where available. Real mechanic per the handoff: sequential glyph chain (cast while Frost Glyph active -> Flame Glyph; cast while Flame Glyph active -> Arcane Glyph), detonated via Glyphic Ruin (bigger hit) or Thaumaturgy (cheap instant). Glyphic Ruin and Thaumaturgy confirmed via screenshot; the glyph-chain-sequencing mechanic itself isn't dynamically modeled yet (Runes resource tracks a count, not which element is active) - see _implementation_note on the capstone.

nodes.name: Wizardry
nodes.description: Increases Intellect by 3 per rank, and increases Mana gained per point of Intellect.

nodes.name: Cosmic Impact
nodes.description: Increases spell critical strike chance and spell haste by 1% per rank.

nodes.name: Well Educated
nodes.description: Increases maximum Mana by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Ley Magician
nodes.description: Increases spell damage scaling from Spirit by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Expert Elementalist
nodes.description: Reduces the cast time of Elemental Burst and Glyphic Ruin by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Glyph Seeker
nodes.description: Increases Primordial Blast and Thaumaturgy damage by 4% per rank.

nodes.name: Concentrated Magic
nodes.description: Increases Spirit by 2% per rank and reduces cast pushback taken.

nodes.name: Mana Runes
nodes.description: Increases maximum Mana and spell critical strike chance by 1% per rank.

nodes.name: Frigid Blast
nodes.description: Learn Frigid Blast, a delayed-release Frost nuke that accumulates damage before detonating.

nodes.name: Primordial Pulse
nodes.description: Learn Primordial Pulse, inscribing an area with runes that repeatedly damage enemies inside.

nodes.name: Glyphic Ruin
nodes.description: Learn Glyphic Ruin, unleashing your active Glyph's effect for a burst of Elemental damage.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: Lvl 20, 'Unleash your active Glyph effect on an enemy and deal 153 Elemental Damage.'

nodes.name: Thaumaturgy
nodes.description: Learn Thaumaturgy, a cheap instant Arcane blast that also unleashes your active Glyph.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: Lvl 36, '99 Arcane damage and unleash your active Glyph effect.'

nodes.name: Unleashed Power
nodes.description: Increases spell power scaling on Glyph unleash effects by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Eye of the Beholder
nodes.description: Increases spell critical strike chance and empowers Glyphic Ruin/Primordial Blast damage for a short window.

nodes.name: Manuscription
nodes.description: Learn Manuscription, a strong Arcane DoT that envelops the target and nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Glyphic Overload
nodes.description: Instantly grants all 3 Glyphs and empowers their next unleash. Usable while stealthed.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as the Glyphic burst capstone: 'Instantly grants all 3 Glyphs + overload: their next unleash gets a bonus effect.' The sequential Frost->Flame->Arcane glyph-chain mechanic this spec is built around isn't dynamically modeled in this engine yet (RUNES resource tracks a count, not which element is currently active) - flag for a real implementation pass before this spec is played seriously.

nodes.name: Devour Mana
nodes.description: Learn Devour Mana, destroying an enemy's mana and dealing Arcane damage based on the amount burned.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Destroys enemy mana; each point burned deals Arcane damage.'

nodes.name: Kirin Tor Adept
nodes.description: Increases the effectiveness of Eye of the Beholder by 8% per rank.

nodes.name: Runic Obliteration
nodes.description: Learn Runic Obliteration, a repeating Elemental-damage missile barrage where each missile grants a Glyph.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Repeating Elemental damage; each missile grants a Glyph.' Short-CD instant filler that both hits and feeds the glyph chain, per the playstyle writeup.

nodes.name: Silencing Rune
nodes.description: Learn Silencing Rune, a ground area that activates after a delay and silences enemies inside.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as a real school-lock/AoE-silence tool: 'Ground area, activates after a delay: silences enemies inside.'

nodes.name: Rune Master
nodes.description: Empower your casting, increasing haste and damage but raising costs, while draining mana. Cannot move while active.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Empowers casting (haste+damage up, cost up) while draining mana; can't move; scales with active-cast dealing damage.' A real channel-style burst cooldown.

nodes.name: Scroll of Magic
nodes.description: Unleashing a Glyph increases your next Unleashed Glyph's damage, stacking.

nodes.name: Primordial Salvos
nodes.description: Unleashing a Glyph now deals extra same-school damage to nearby enemies.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Unleashing a Glyph deals extra same-school damage to nearby enemies.' Confirmed as the mechanism behind Arcane Unleash's AoE splash in the playstyle writeup.

nodes.name: Kirin Tor Agent
nodes.description: While Eye of the Beholder is active, your Rune spell and Phase Out cooldowns are rapidly reduced.

nodes.name: Unmaker
nodes.description: Increases Glyphic Ruin's critical strike damage and grants Cosmic Impact.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts Glyphic Ruin crit damage; grants Cosmic Impact.'

nodes.name: Mind Wrath
nodes.description: Ley Lock now interrupts an additional nearby enemy.

nodes.name: Glyphs of Power
nodes.description: Direct damage has a chance to restore mana.

nodes.name: Ley Walker
nodes.description: Warpdagger's cast and reactivation remove root and snare effects from you.

nodes.name: Phase Rush
nodes.description: Casting Thaumaturgy grants a burst of movement speed.

nodes.name: Arcane Student
nodes.description: Guarantees Glyphic Ruin critically strikes while Eye of the Beholder is active.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc, referenced in Glyphic's Strengths writeup: 'Arcane Student guaranteeing the Glyphic Ruin crit' when layered with Eye of the Beholder + Glyphic Overload for burst.

nodes.name: Cold Elements
nodes.description: Elemental Burst and Primordial Blast have a chance to reset and instant-cast your next Frigid Blast.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc, Glyphic's Strengths/Weaknesses writeup: 'Cold Elements resets/instant-casts Frigid Blast' - keeps a hard Frost nuke available alongside the glyph chain.
